items.title: 千问办公 QwenWork：设备码登录选团队，档位 + 直通模型
items.body: 阿里办公 Agent 双站接入（国际 qwenwork.ai / 国内 qwenwork.cn）：设备码登录，授权页选团队即按其套餐计费。标准 / 高级 / 旗舰档位 + Qwen4-Max 等直通模型全系 1M 上下文。注意：刷新令牌只由网关刷新，勿同时登录官方桌面客户端；Free 档调直通模型 403（付费解锁）。
items.titleEn: QwenWork: device-code sign-in with team billing, tiers + direct models
items.bodyEn: Alibaba's workplace agent joins (intl qwenwork.ai / CN qwenwork.cn): device-code sign-in, pick a team and its plan pays the credits. Standard / Advanced / Flagship tiers plus direct models like Qwen4-Max, all 1M context. Note: refresh tokens are gateway-only — don't sign into the official desktop app simultaneously; Free plans get 403 on direct models.

items.title: Capy：一次请求一轮真实 agent，免开桌面端
items.body: agent 平台接入：一次请求就是一轮真实 agent 任务，线程复用、不需要开着官方桌面端；邮箱验证码登录。三个全 0 计费免费模型（GLM-5.3-Flash 广告版 / DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 广告版 / Particle-1）。须知：配对的无头设备与桌面端一样会执行命令与文件操作——不需要此能力就不配对设备即可。
items.titleEn: Capy: one request = one real agent run, no desktop app needed
items.bodyEn: Agent platform: each request is one real agent run — threads are reused and the official desktop app need not be running; sign in with an email code. Three free all-zero-priced models (GLM-5.3-Flash ads / DeepSeek V4.1 Flash ads / Particle-1). Notice: a paired headless device executes commands and file operations like the desktop app does — don't pair a device if you don't want that.

items.title: CrowLLM：180+ 模型一个 Key，40 个 :free 零倍率
items.body: one-hub 聚合网关：一个 API Key 透传 180+ 模型；带 :free 后缀的模型完全免费（40 个，含 qwen4-max:free，实测日成功率 91%+、延迟偏高）。「获取 API 密钥」入口接邀请码池轮换。
items.titleEn: CrowLLM: 180+ models behind one key, 40 :free at zero rate
items.bodyEn: one-hub aggregator gateway: one API key unlocks 180+ passthrough models; :free models cost nothing (40 of them, incl. qwen4-max:free — 91%+ daily success, latency on the slow side). The Get API Key entry rotates an invite pool.

items.title: Croli：Clerk OAuth + 积分池，原生签到与积分面板
items.body: Clerk OAuth（Google / GitHub / 邮箱）面板内登录。每日签到 +100（连续加成）、每日首聊 +200（真实回合上报，不烧 trial 额度）；详情页带积分任务中心，实验性页可开自动签到。注册引导走邀请码池。
items.titleEn: Croli: Clerk OAuth + credits pool, native check-in and credits panel
items.bodyEn: Clerk OAuth (Google / GitHub / email) entirely in the panel. Daily check-in +100 (streak bonuses), first chat of the day +200 — reported from real completed turns, no trial quota burned; the detail page carries a task center and the Experimental page adds auto check-in. Signup rotates an invite pool.

items.title: Nous Portal：设备码登录，免费档免绑卡
items.body: Hermes 同款设备码 OAuth：授权后把「复制此 URL」粘回面板即完成登录。免费档 qwen4-max:free 等免绑卡；实时目录 400+ 模型透传。注意：刷新令牌只由网关刷新，勿同时登录 Hermes CLI。
items.titleEn: Nous Portal: device-code sign-in, free tier without a card
items.bodyEn: Hermes-style device-code OAuth: paste the "copy this URL" page back into the panel to finish. Free tier (qwen4-max:free and friends) needs no card; 400+ models passthrough. Note: gateway-only refresh — don't sign into the Hermes CLI simultaneously.

items.title: 许可证已生效：自 v1.8.1 起改为 AGPL-3.0（此前为 MIT）
items.body: 自 v1.8.1 起本仓库整体采用 AGPL-3.0；v1.8.0 及更早版本维持 MIT。日常使用、自部署不受影响；任何二次利用（含网络服务形式）需同协议开源。
items.titleEn: License in effect: AGPL-3.0 starting with v1.8.1 (previously MIT)
items.bodyEn: The repository ships under AGPL-3.0 since v1.8.1; releases up to v1.8.0 remain MIT. Everyday use and self-hosting are unaffected; any reuse — including as a network service — must stay under the same license.

items.title: Qoder 排队机制与账号风控说明
items.body: 部分 Qoder 账号持续排队（10605）是官方账号级风控慢速队列；订阅套餐有专属优先通道。10Router 自动识别并冷却顺延至其他可用账号。
items.titleEn: Qoder queue throttle and account rate-limit explained
items.bodyEn: Continuous queueing on some Qoder accounts (10605) is the official per-account slow lane; subscribed plans get a priority lane. 10Router detects it and fails over automatically.

items.title: DeepAI Code 供应商：27 模型免费档，面板内直接登录
items.body: deepai.org 桌面编程 agent 接入免费额度区：11 个免费不计量模型 + 16 个按次花每日 Theos。面板内 Google/Apple 登录粘回即建连，也可直接粘贴已有 Key。
items.titleEn: DeepAI Code provider: 27 models free-tier, panel-native sign-in
items.bodyEn: DeepAI Code (deepai.org coding agent) joins the free tier: 11 unmetered models + 16 metered against the daily Theos grant. Google/Apple sign-in runs in the panel — paste the callback back, or paste an existing key.

items.title: WPS 灵犀供应商：粘贴 Cookie 即用，原生签到与到期桶
items.body: 供应商页 Capture Session 三步引导（书签签 / 直接粘贴）或从 CreditDaddy 一键同步。配额卡按智点口径呈现——余额 + 逐包到期桶 + 倒计时；实验性页可开每日自动领灵点（100/天、第七天 200）。免费档日常对话不扣灵点。
items.titleEn: WPS Lingxi provider: paste a cookie to start, native check-in and expiry buckets
items.bodyEn: Capture Session on the provider page (bookmarklet or direct paste), or one-click sync from CreditDaddy. The quota card speaks credits — balance + expiry buckets + countdown; the Experimental page adds auto daily claim (100/day, 200 on day seven). Free-tier chat costs no credits.

items.title: Meoo 秒悟供应商：OAuth 登录 / 控制面 Key 双通道
items.body: OAuth（CLI 同款 PKCE）或粘贴控制面 Key 双通道接入；项目服务 AK 自动解析、失效自愈。积分账户完整呈现——余额 + 逐包到期；实验性页可开每日自动领积分。
items.titleEn: Meoo provider: OAuth or control-plane key, full points ledger
items.bodyEn: Connect via OAuth (CLI-style PKCE) or a control-plane key; the per-project AK resolves itself and self-heals. Points ledger shows balance + per-batch expiry; the Experimental page adds an auto daily-claim toggle.
